value_intent: Prevent silent post-output reinterpretation while keeping a 3-5 case proof of concept operationally small.

CASE_AUTHOR.responsibility: Create the Natural Situation without model output.

EXPECTATION_AUTHOR.responsibility: Define material constraints before Semantic Agent output exists.
must_not_use: Semantic Agent output for this execution

SEMANTIC_AGENT.responsibility: Produce only observable Semantic Judgment from allowed input.

OUTPUT_ANNOTATOR.responsibility: Annotate preserved observable output without changing it.

DETERMINISTIC_EVALUATOR.responsibility: Apply the frozen counter-failure evaluation baseline.

DISAGREEMENT_REVIEWER.responsibility: Review unresolved disagreement without rewriting sealed history.

HUMAN_DECISION.responsibility: Retain material normative and authority decisions.
may_know: all observable evidence and review records

sealing.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; sorted keys; separators comma/colon; one LF

counter_challenges.governance_too_heavy: One protocol, one case record, four seals, one annotation, and review only on disagreement.
counter_challenges.fake_role_independence: Actor identity and overlap are recorded; labels alone do not establish independence.
counter_challenges.over_specified_answer: Constraint classes replace an exact narrative or single required route.
counter_challenges.annotator_follows_expectation: Expectation exposure before annotation is recorded as an independence limitation.
counter_challenges.review_rewrites_history: Post-hoc review references both immutable original and proposed hashes.
counter_challenges.all_cases_contaminated: Only explicit exposure, chronology, provenance, prior-use, or baseline breaches contaminate.
counter_challenges.human_approval_bottleneck: Human review is limited to normative authority and unresolved disagreement.
